name: Marketplace MVP for Sustainable Goods
problem: The founders needed a fast‑to‑market B2C marketplace to sell eco‑friendly products.
solution: Built a server‑rendered Next.js storefront with a custom checkout flow integrated with Stripe, and a Node/Express API backed by PostgreSQL via Prisma. Deployed with Docker on AWS ECS.

name: Real‑time Fleet Tracking Dashboard
problem: The logistics firm needed a live view of vehicle locations and status updates for dispatchers.
solution: Implemented a GraphQL API feeding real‑time telemetry stored in Redis, with a React/TypeScript dashboard consuming the data via Apollo. CI/CD pipelines automated testing and Docker image builds.

name: Property Listings Portal – Phase 1
problem: A regional agency wanted an online portal to showcase rentals and sales listings.
solution: Delivered a SEO‑optimized Next.js site with server‑side rendering, Prisma ORM for PostgreSQL, and responsive UI built with Tailwind.
outcome_metrics: 30% increase in lead generation within 2 months
SEO ranking for target keywords moved to page 1

name: Property Listings Portal – Phase 2 (Booking Engine)
problem: The agency needed a way for prospects to schedule viewings directly from listings.
solution: Added a Django REST backend with booking endpoints and a React modal booking component; integrated email notifications via SendGrid.
outcome_metrics: Reduced manual admin work by 20 hours/month

name: Property Listings Portal – Phase 3 (Analytics)
problem: The agency wanted insight into listing performance and user interaction.
solution: Built a GraphQL analytics service aggregating event data in Redis and persisting summaries to PostgreSQL; displayed dashboards with Chart.js in the existing portal.
outcome_metrics: Agent dashboards adopted by 90% of staff
Data‑driven pricing adjustments increased average sale price by 4%

name: Telehealth Video Consultation Platform
problem: A hospital network required a secure, HIPAA‑compliant video visit system for patients.
solution: Implemented a React front‑end with Twilio Video integration and a Node/Express API handling session tokens, storing appointments in PostgreSQL. End‑to‑end tests written in Playwright.
outcome_metrics: Supported 5,000+ video visits in the first quarter

name: Reservation System for Boutique Hotels
problem: A small hotel chain needed an online booking engine with instant payment capture.
solution: Created a serverless Next.js app backed by Supabase for auth and data, integrated Stripe Checkout for payments, and styled with Tailwind for fast iteration.
outcome_metrics: Occupancy rate rose from 62% to 78% in 6 months

name: Compliance Document Generator
problem: The legal department needed a self‑service tool to produce customized contracts.
solution: Built a Django REST service that merges templates with user data via docxtpl, and a React UI for form entry and PDF preview.
outcome_metrics: Reduced contract drafting time from 4 hours to 15 minutes

name: Production Line KPI Dashboard
problem: Factory managers lacked real‑time visibility into equipment efficiency.
solution: Created a GraphQL API that aggregates sensor data stored in PostgreSQL and a React dashboard with Recharts visualizations.

name: Adaptive Learning Platform
problem: A tutoring agency wanted a web app that adapts content difficulty based on student performance.
solution: Implemented server‑side rendered Next.js with Prisma ORM, authentication via next‑auth, and an algorithmic engine that updates difficulty levels on each quiz submission.

name: Micro‑lending Platform API
problem: The fintech needed a secure API to manage loan applications, disbursements, and repayments.
solution: Developed a TypeScript‑based Express API with TypeORM for PostgreSQL, Redis caching for credit‑score lookups, and Stripe Connect for payouts.
outcome_metrics: Average approval time cut from 48 h to 6 h

name: Volunteer Coordination Portal
problem: A community organizer needed a simple site to manage events and volunteer sign‑ups.
solution: Built a multilingual Next.js site with Supabase auth and database, styled with Tailwind, allowing volunteers to register and track hours.

name: Content Publishing Engine
problem: A media agency required a headless CMS to deliver articles across web and mobile channels.
solution: Deployed Django CMS as a headless backend with REST endpoints, and a React front‑end that renders markdown content with client‑side routing.
outcome_metrics: Supported 3 mobile apps and 2 web properties

name: Dynamic Pricing Service
problem: The retailer needed real‑time price adjustments based on inventory and competitor data.
solution: Implemented a microservice that pulls competitor feeds, computes price rules, caches results in Redis, and updates product tables in PostgreSQL on a cron schedule.

name: Internal Audit Workflow Tool
problem: The compliance team needed a way to assign, track, and review audit tasks across departments.
solution: Created a Kanban‑style React app with drag‑and‑drop, backed by a GraphQL API that persists task state in PostgreSQL.
